answer: The strongest single control I know for this is AI-generated content detector score proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 679 aliases need 679 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. One quartz of signal, one signal of cost, one harbor of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
